definitions.explanation: a polite or formal expression of regret or apology

examples.japanese: お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
{遅|おく}れてしまい、お{詫|わ}びいたします。
お{詫|わ}びの{品|しな}を{持|も}って{行|い}った。
examples.english: I brought a gift as an apology.

notes:
FORMALITY:
Polite/formal (お + {詫|わ}び). The お- prefix makes it more polite.

USAGE:
- お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます (I humbly apologize - very formal)
- お{詫|わ}びいたします (I apologize - formal)
- お{詫|わ}びの{言葉|ことば} (words of apology)
- お{詫|わ}びの{品|しな}/{印|しるし} (gift of apology)

IN BUSINESS:
- お{詫|わ}び{状|じょう} (letter of apology)
- お{詫|わ}び{文|ぶん} (apology statement)
- お{詫|わ}びとお{知|し}らせ (apology and notice)

COMPARISON:
- お{詫|わ}び (formal apology)
- {謝罪|しゃざい} (apology - more formal, often public)
- ごめんなさい (sorry - casual)

RELATED:
- {詫|わ}びる (to apologize - verb)
- {謝|あやま}る (to apologize)
- {陳謝|ちんしゃ} (formal apology)
